kind: Profile 7 MEL diagnosis, libplacebo source fix and pre-install qualification
owner_report: A newly downloaded Profile 7 title showed no FEL pill and 'display mapper unavailable' in plurx Player 0.5.5 with mpv +rogdv5.7.

diagnosis.provider_decline: Every mapper call in an attended play (about 1,300) had the enhancement layer not composed and RPU present; the provider returned 0 with 'unsupported residual: shared frontend has no verified enhancement-layer reconstruction'.
ruled_out: Source file: Profile 7 dual-layer single track, 1920x1080 Main 10 enhancement layer under a 3840x2160 base, one RPU per access unit, the same layout as a working FEL title.

Server route: the title had no prepared VOD index and was served by the temporary live-HLS copy remux; a working FEL title used the identical ffmpeg command, and re-running it preserved every enhancement-layer and RPU NAL unit.
Live HLS bytes: the session's init.mp4 declared Profile 7 with el_present_flag=1; its segments carried 6,404 enhancement-layer and 565 RPU NAL units.
mpv splitting and pairing: the Profile 7 splitter started and every base picture was paired with its enhancement picture.
diagnosis.cause: The title is MEL. Every sampled RPU had disable_residual_flag=0 with an identity linear dead-zone NLQ: nlq_offset=0, linear_deadzone_slope=0, linear_deadzone_threshold=0 and vdr_in_max=2^23 at coef_log2_denom=23. libplacebo's NLQ mapping marks that frame nlq_active=false, so the renderer dropped the bound enhancement layer and reported enhancement_layer_composed=false. The provider, reading disable_residual_flag=0 from the raw RPU, requires a reconstructed master and declined. The working FEL title had nlq_offset=512 and linear_deadzone_slope=2048.
diagnosis.same_failure_outside_the_player: With the player's mpv options in an ordinary window, the original file (two timestamps), the captured live bytes and a software-decode run all declined.

fix.change: When a Dolby Vision enhancement layer is bound but the frame's RPU applies no residual, the renderer records it and reports the master as reconstructed. The layer is not sampled. FFmpeg rejects every NLQ method except linear dead zone, so with a parsed RPU nlq_active=false means the residual is disabled, absent or identity, each contributing exactly zero.
fix.build: Stock candidate and patched trees built in a throwaway ubuntu:26.10 container on the ROG with the original options (debugoptimized, vulkan and dovi enabled), gcc 15.3.0, the private libdovi 3.3.2-3+rogdv1; zero warnings; identical exported symbols (537).

qualification.method: Installed mpv +rogdv5.7 with the player's options, paused window screenshot after playback restart, LD_LIBRARY_PATH selecting each library; no package installed.
qualification.build_control: The stock rebuild and the installed library produced identical screenshots for the MEL title and a FEL title.

release.packages: libplacebo-rog387 1.0.0+private20261108-3 carries the patched library. Six packages pin it or a dependent exactly and are metadata-only +depfix1 repacks with byte-identical contents: librog-dv-provider387-1 1.0.0+private20261108-5+depfix1, mpv 0.42.0-0ubuntu0+rogdv5.7+depfix1, libgstgtk-dovi-core0 0.1.0+rogdv10+depfix1, gstreamer1.0-gtk-dovi 0.1.0+rogdv10+depfix1, gstreamer1.0-gtk4 0.15.2-1ubuntu2+rogdv5.8+depfix1, showtime 50.0-2+rogdv5.15+depfix1.
release.plan: Release tooling plan: 7 package changes, 0 removals; preflight re-verified the exact live simulation and all 14 archive digests.

limits: Digital checks of the mapper's decision and window pixels; no optical measurement.
Paused single-frame screenshots at one timestamp per title, not continuous playback.
The browser and Showtime GStreamer route use the same library but were not exercised.
The server's FEL label for an MEL title is unchanged and is a separate follow-up.
